title: TWO PLAYERS NEVER LOOK ALIKE
why: His order of 2026-10-15: for the party on the 30th, both players of the two-player DEMO must look great and clearly different. When two people are linked in a co-op or DEMO game, every player now carries a seat mark that both windows draw the same: a ring on the ground at the feet (player 1 amber, player 2 cyan, then lime and pink) with its number on a badge. And if both picked the same colour scheme, which two fresh profiles always do, the second seat is drawn in the next free preset (Frost, then Ember, Verdant) in both windows, so the two are different at a glance before anyone opens FASHION. A scheme you picked yourself is kept when the other player picked something else. A PvP match keeps its red and blue. Cosmetic only.
now: In a two-player game each player now has a coloured ring and a number, and two matching looks are told apart.
